text:
rachel: Starting deploy for llm-router v2.3.4 in the maintenance window. We'll toggle feature flag `llmroute_cohort_split` for a staggered rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 35%. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.3.4

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy initiated for service=llm-router version=v2.3.4 by rachel. Canary -> staged prod ramps.

tom: Requesting a 2-phase hold: keep at 2% for 12m then evaluate telemetry. Gates: p95 <= 250ms, 5xx <= 0.4%, queue length delta < +15%. If any gate fails, we disable flag and pin to v2.3.2.

rachel: noted. Pinned model in deploy manifest: `model.pin = "v2.3.4"` for the rolled cohorts; will remove pin after stable for 24h.

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_cohort_split` -> 2% prod cohorts by rachel. Internal override: QA 100%.

priya: smoke after 7m: chat flows look good. p95=240ms, 5xx=0.1%, small queue bump +7%. thumbs up.

sre-oncall: monitoring infra. Saw a short spike on router-node-7 (cpu 82%) at start then back to normal. Runbook rollback thresholds set: p95 > 500ms OR 5xx > 1% sustained for 2m => auto-disable flag. Disable via CLI: `/deploybot flag disable llmroute_cohort_split` or Console: https://redwood.internal/flags/llmroute_cohort_split

tom: if queue pressure grows but errors remain low, prefer soft-throttle at edge per runbook rather than immediate disable.

rachel: planning to ramp to 10% at +15m if gates hold. Scheduling manual approval.

deploy-bot: Scheduled action pending: ramp `llmroute_cohort_split` -> 10% at +15m (manual approve required).

rachel: /approve ramp to 10%.

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_cohort_split` -> 10% by rachel.

priya: post-ramp (5m): p95=255ms, 5xx=0.3%, queue delta +12%. Slightly above target p95 but still below emergency threshold. Recommend hold for full 30m before next ramp.

sre-oncall: agreed. Leaving the pin in place and continuing telemetry capture. Will alert on any degradation.

tom: adding to release notes: "Staged cohort split (2% -> 10%); fallback to v2.3.2 and automated flag disable on breach. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/llmroute-rollback"

rachel: release notes updated and changelog pinned. We'll reconvene in 30m for decision on 35% ramp. Thanks all.
